summary: Install-time fetch and execute of a dependency tarball from a non-registry host
details: package.json declares a dependency `packet-table-thread-stream` resolved directly to a tarball URL on `artifacts.yosiroute.com` — a host unrelated to the npm registry and to any declared publisher. npm-shrinkwrap.json marks that dependency `hasInstallScript: true`, so on `npm install` of this package, npm downloads the tarball from `artifacts.yosiroute.com` and runs its lifecycle install script on the installer's machine. The dependency is pinned only by URL (no version, no integrity hash), so the operator of `yosiroute.com` can serve arbitrary code to every installer at any time. Package metadata reinforces the drop-shape: placeholder `author` ('Package Registry'), placeholder repository (`github.com/example/...`), and an unusual version (`0.1.999`) consistent with a dependency-confusion lure targeting a `merchantweb-*` internal namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
